product_metadata.title: binca vidou Reed Diffuser Bergamot & Cantaloupe, Home Scented Oil Reed Diffuser Set for Bedroom Livingroom, Remove Bad Smells, Strong & Long Lasting Fragrance for 50 Days, 100 ml/3.4 oz
features: Sophisticated Fragrances - Top notes: lemon, bergamot, marigold, cantaloupe; middle notes: black currant, pineapple; base notes: white cedar, amber, white musk smells rich and exotic. No smoke, flame-free, rejuvenate with this smooth and peaceful scent.

Long Lasting Scent - reed sticks absorb fragrance oils and release an evocative fragrance in the air for 50 days. Simple yet Elegant Artistic bottle looks like a work of art! Makes a beautiful complement to any home decor.
Easy Intensity Control - 8 sticks come in the box. By adding or removing the sticks, you can control the fragrance at desired intensity, or flip the reeds regularly for a burst of fresh scent.
Perfect Gift Idea - Ideal gift for friends and loved ones, for housewarming, birthdays, and Anniversaries. It's always a pleasure to see everyone receive the product and smile with joy.
Odor Dispelling - Scent your space with soothing and fresh fragrance to eliminate the bad smells. Put it in the bedroom. living room, bathroom, kitchen, hallway and office to add a fresh smell.
